verdict.rationale: ImageMagick is software you build and run on your own machines: it is written in C for Linux, Windows and macOS, documents configure-script build options, and offers security policies tailored to your own server environment. Community users ship it inside their own apps, use Windows installers or portable zips, and recommend making your own build. missing for 10: explicit first-party statement of the open-source license in the evidence pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: It is written in C and can be used on a variety of operating systems, including Linux, Windows, and macOS.
For a Q8 non-HDRI build of ImageMagick, use these configure script options: --with-quantum-depth=8 --disable-hdri.
Tailor security policies to suit your server environment.
